About Blue Fox in Longwood

Local landscaping and exterior cleaning.

Blue Fox Landscape & Services in Longwood, FL, offers professional landscape design and construction services, power washing & soft washing for commercial and residential properties. We do all things landscaping, such as designing and installing patios, driveways and walkways. We offer pressure washing to thoroughly clean your driveways, patios, decks, fencing, gates and more, and soft washing for roofs, whole house exteriors and gutters, so they are free of mold, mildew, dirt and grime.

Questions

Before you call.

Do you serve Longwood?

Yes. Longwood is one of the five communities in our established service area, for residential and commercial properties.

Is the estimate free?

Yes. Estimates are free. The only published fee is digital landscape design work: as of 7/1/2023 it is $250, with a 50% deposit, and the $250 is credited toward the landscape project if the package is approved.

Can you do landscaping and washing on the same property?

Yes. Both halves are handled by one company, so they can be scoped and scheduled together.
